presets.title: Presets
presets.lead: Formats, win conditions and tiebreak orders saved on this PC, for every tournament.
presets.name: Preset name

pools.name: Pools only
pools.description: Pools of 4 (else 5), everyone ranked by pool position.

poolsMain.name: Pools + main bracket
poolsMain.description: Pools of 4 (else 5); the top two of each pool in a bracket with every place played.

poolsMainConsolation.name: Pools + main + consolation
poolsMainConsolation.description: Pools of 4 (else 5); ranks 1-2 in the main bracket, everyone else in a consolation bracket.

bracket.name: Bracket with every place
bracket.description: Straight knockout from the draw, every place played.

twoPoolRounds.name: Two pool rounds + final
twoPoolRounds.description: Pools of 4 (else 5), the top two in new pools, then a final bracket for their top two.

poolsBest16.name: Pools + best 16 + consolation
poolsBest16.description: Pools of 4 (else 5); the 16 best in the main bracket, compared across pools, the rest in a consolation bracket.

presets.offeredHint: Unchecked, this preset is no longer offered in tournaments. It stays here.

schedule.title: Schedule
schedule.summary: {n, plural, one {# match} other {# matches}} left · expected end around {end} · minimum rest {rest} min
schedule.empty: Nothing to schedule yet: enter players and set a format.
schedule.unrested: {n, plural, one {# match without its rest} other {# matches without their rest}}
schedule.unrestedHint: No rested match fitted the rules there: the desk calls it anyway, or changes the order of the blocks.
schedule.alternateHint: Round 1 of one category, round 1 of the other, then round 2…
schedule.reservedHint: Each category keeps its courts until it is over; its courts then go to the other.
schedule.autoHint: Automatic: same pool in a row, pools with the most rounds left first, bracket rounds one after the other. Move a block to change the order.
schedule.manualHint: Order set by hand: courts take the blocks in this order, as soon as their players are free.
